description:
A call center is expanding its outbound fundraising campaign (WFHCAMP) to include work-from-home agents who connect via their home phone lines. You need to create 3 remote agent entries in the Vicidial admin panel so the predictive dialer will automatically call each agent's external phone number and bridge them into live calls.

Navigate to the Remote Agents section in the Vicidial admin panel (Admin > Remote Agents) and create the following three entries:

1. Remote Agent 7201:
   - User Start: 7201
   - Number of Lines: 1
   - Server IP: (Select the active server IP shown in the dropdown or system)
   - Conference Extension: 8600051
   - Status: ACTIVE
   - Campaign: WFHCAMP
   - External Extension: 2022243121

2. Remote Agent 7202:
   - User Start: 7202
   - Number of Lines: 1
   - Server IP: (Same as above)
   - Conference Extension: 8600052
   - Status: ACTIVE
   - Campaign: WFHCAMP
   - External Extension: 2022244343

3. Remote Agent 7203:
   - User Start: 7203
   - Number of Lines: 2
   - Server IP: (Same as above)
   - Conference Extension: 8600053
   - Status: ACTIVE
   - Campaign: WFHCAMP
   - External Extension: 2022245721

After creating all three entries, navigate back to the Remote Agents listing to confirm they all appear.

Vicidial admin credentials: username 6666, password andromeda
Vicidial admin URL: http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php
